From what I see, many people came to Voat for the same reasons that I did - they felt censored or at the very least, shouted down when they presented alternate viewpoints on other sites.

There is no back and forth - in fact, most of the commentary seems to be firmly rooted in proactively ridiculing an ideology that doesn't even seem to be present on the site. I can definitely understand being frustrated with having to leave somewhere because your ideas were not accepted, but now those people that were rejected are turning their new habitation into the same kind of place - where ideas are not constructively debated - but rather people and their straw men caricatures are ridiculed.

My main question - if this is all an accurate assessment of what is going on here; then, is this the natural progression of societies? Are the frontiers the most hateful, ignorant and scathing places more so because of the scorned people that have moved there than because of the untended terrain? Are people so hurt by being rejected by their previous "societies" that they are unable to see that they become the monsters they hate?

My second question is - when does this all end? When are people able to rise above and apply the same principles they reserve for themselves to others? Why is it so difficult for us to turn the other cheek and treat others as we want to be treated, particularly when we are hurt?
